# A09-S177: Event access

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

Could we say that participation is free, but that one has to have responded to the invitation to get in?

The guards could also play an important role.

And it’s still realistic regarding those coming from far away.

We could have a MobilePay number, which people pay a one-time amount to for food and beverages when they come?

And does anyone have a subscription to TV2? 😂
